personalInfo.aboutMe: Senior Frontend Developer with 8+ years of experience in React, Next.js, Vue and TypeScript, all in B2B SaaS. Core strengths are micro-frontend architecture, web performance, testing at scale and reusable design systems. At Nexus I own the frontend architecture of an enterprise collaboration suite — chat, calendar, video meetings, tasks, tickets and AI meeting recaps — serving 30,000+ active users, and I set the frontend standards and code-review practice adopted across the company's ~15 frontend engineers. Measured outcomes include a 40% reduction in data-fetch latency, 60% fewer build failures across 25+ CI/CD pipelines, and Core Web Vitals 'Green' with 25% faster initial load.

description: Owned the frontend architecture for the rebuild of an enterprise collaboration suite — chat, calendar, video meetings, tasks, tickets and AI meeting recaps — serving 30,000+ active users, introducing Zustand, React Query and IndexedDB for offline-first behaviour; data-fetch latency fell 40%.
Split the product into a Module Federation micro-frontend estate of 6+ independent modules, trimming average deploy time by 30% and removing cross-team release dependencies.
Cut the regression cycle by 30% with the company's first end-to-end test suite in Playwright, written against user stories, and held unit coverage above 60% with Jest and React Testing Library.
Set up 25+ CI/CD pipelines and containerised services with Docker, dropping build failures by 60%.
Built the AI meeting-recap experience — a post-meeting summary page distributed to attendees by link — now producing 300+ recaps per month.
Set the frontend standards and code-review practice adopted across the company's ~15 frontend engineers, and ran weekly sessions on advanced React patterns and AI tooling; team velocity grew 35%.

Migrated 4+ legacy applications off classic ASP.NET inside the .NET MVC host — 3+ Razor projects to Angular single-page applications (payroll, work-calendar) and one jQuery/Razor frontend to React — cutting screen-development time and enabling client-side computation the Razor stack could not support.
Built 10+ mission-critical admin dashboards in React and Angular for a workforce-management platform serving 100,000+ users.
Improved initial page load by 25% and reached Core Web Vitals 'Green' by auditing bundle composition to isolate the heaviest render-blocking dependencies, then code-splitting the routes.
Traced 58% of defects to untyped shared state, then migrated the monolithic frontend to TypeScript and Redux Toolkit to eliminate that defect class, cutting new-engineer onboarding by 2 weeks.
Built a geofenced attendance module with Leaflet and Mapbox, lifting use of location-aware features by 30%.
Reduced post-release defects by 20% across a product used by 3,000+ enterprise clients by putting structured code review and Jest unit testing in place.
